name: Mai Khao
intro: Mai Khao is Phuket's longest and most natural beach, stretching along the north-west coast inside Sirinat National Park. It is home to large resorts and a few residential projects, with the airport at its southern end.
overview:
Mai Khao is the northernmost of the areas in our catalogue, on Phuket's north-west coast in Thalang district, beyond Nai Yang. We list two projects here: a condominium (Maviston Mai Khao) and a private pool villa development near Mai Khao Beach.
Our project data has no distances for this area yet, so ask us for travel times to the beach and the airport.
suitableFor: Buyers who want privacy and nature

lifestyle: Mai Khao is very quiet, with resort restaurants, a small local village and the Turtle Village shopping area. Most daily needs are a drive away.
beaches: Mai Khao Beach runs for many kilometres with few buildings. Its southern end is famous for planes landing just overhead. The beach is a nesting site for sea turtles, and waves can be strong during the monsoon.
rentalMarket: Rentals in Mai Khao are mostly resort-managed holiday stays. The market is small and focused on guests who want a quiet, natural beach.

rentalDetails.title: Short-term holiday rentals
rentalDetails.text: Resort and condotel units let to holiday guests, mainly in the dry season.

rentalDetails.title: Long-term rentals
rentalDetails.text: Limited, because daily amenities are far away.

rentalDetails.title: Advantages and limitations
rentalDetails.text: Advantage: unique, uncrowded beach. Limitations: few services, distance to the rest of the island and a small tenant pool.

investment: Mai Khao suits buyers who prioritise nature and privacy, often with resort management. Rental income is typically seasonal and depends on the operator.

investmentDetails.title: Risks to consider
investmentDetails.text: Small market, reliance on the resort operator and national park restrictions.

investmentDetails.title: Ownership costs
investmentDetails.text: Resort fees, management commission and maintenance.

faq.question: Is Mai Khao the longest beach in Phuket?
faq.answer: Yes, Mai Khao is generally described as Phuket's longest beach, running along the north-west coast inside Sirinat National Park.

faq.question: Can you watch planes at Mai Khao Beach?
faq.answer: Yes, the southern end of the beach is close to the runway and planes land just overhead.

faq.question: Is Mai Khao good for swimming?
faq.answer: In the dry season, yes; from about May to October the waves and currents can be strong.

faq.question: How far is Mai Khao from the airport?
faq.answer: Our project data gives about 10 to 17 km to Phuket International Airport.

faq.question: Are there shops and restaurants in Mai Khao?
faq.answer: There are resort restaurants and the Turtle Village shopping area, but larger amenities are a drive away.
